article.title: The enduring relevance of Gramsci, 100 years after his arrest
article.author: Editor
article.content: One hundred years after Antonio Gramsci’s arrest, the striking relevance of his ideas and the example set by his own life remain a living legacy that must be reclaimed and defended. The post The enduring relevance of Gramsci, 100 years after his arrest appeared first on MR Online .
